items.title: Senator Faroole oo ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo xiriirka Imaaraadka
items.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Puntland senator Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku sheegay in uu dhammaaday muddo-xileedkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh…
items.excerpt: Madaxweynihii hore ee Puntland senator Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku sheegay in uu dhammaaday muddo-xileedkii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo labada aqal ee baarlamaanka Soomaaliya. Senator Faroole wuxuu tixraacay go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee 5-tii Nofeembar 2026, kaas oo sheegayay in uu dhammaaday muddo-xileedka dowladda, kuna baaqayay in hannaanka doorashada lagu heshiiyo 30 maalmood gudahood, doorashadana lagu qabto 90 berri gudahood. Dhanka kale senator Cabdiraxmaan Faroole wuxuu dhaliilay hadalladii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ku saabsanaa
